scope_a_tp_pattern_candidates.name: TP_PATTERN
scope_a_tp_pattern_candidates.definition: frozen trend_pullback() pattern candidates over the full development window

scope_b_tp_post_factor_candidates.name: TP_POST_FACTOR
scope_b_tp_post_factor_candidates.definition: Scope A candidates whose frozen factor assessment has no blocked reason

br_reference_post_factor.name: BR_POST_FACTOR
br_reference_post_factor.definition: frozen breakout_retest() pattern candidates whose frozen factor assessment has no blocked reason

br_reference_risk_pass.name: BR_RISK_PASS
br_reference_risk_pass.definition: BR post-factor candidates whose frozen position plan passes rr_min and notional

horizons.window_rule: first 1m bar strictly after the candidate decision close
horizons.truncation_rule: window truncated at development_end_exclusive is marked incomplete and excluded from reachability denominators

excursion_definitions.mfe: max favorable excursion of 1m high for LONG or 1m low for SHORT against the decision close
excursion_definitions.mae: max adverse excursion of 1m low for LONG or 1m high for SHORT against the decision close
excursion_definitions.time_to_extreme: minutes from decision close to the first bar achieving the extreme
excursion_definitions.diagnostic_only: excursion labels are not trades and never produce PnL

entry_lag_audit.interpretation_rule: previous-extreme-break confirmation is only evaluated on the final candidate bar by the frozen setup, so its timestamp equals the candidate timestamp

local_extreme_stop.static_rule: diagnostic only; never selects an entry or produces a candidate recommendation

entry_references.supplementary_note: the pullback extreme is knowable at candidate time from the last five 15m bars; it is a static diagnostic anchor only and does not select an entry
entry_references.static_rule: diagnostic only; frozen entry remains unchanged

reachability.ordering_rule: a threshold is reached-before-stop only if the first favorable touch precedes the first touch of the frozen stop; invalidation and local-extreme first-touch timestamps are recorded separately
reachability.label: counterfactual reach ordering, not a PnL backtest

barrier_audit.barrier_definition: confirmed pivots strictly between the decision close and the 2.5 ATR projected target, opposite-kind pivots relative to the trade direction

year_direction_stability.rule: core diagnostics reported per year and per direction to prevent single-year conclusions

H6_confirmed_swing_too_old_or_far.evidence: invalidation pivot age and distance distributions per year and direction
H6_confirmed_swing_too_old_or_far.support_rule: median invalidation distance exceeds the median pullback local-extreme distance by at least 0.5 ATR in every year with at least 5 candidates (material width), regardless of pivot age
H6_confirmed_swing_too_old_or_far.falsification_rule: any full year shows a swing-to-extreme gap below 0.5 ATR, or local-extreme stops materially raise net RR pass beyond the frozen stop baseline while the gap is absent
H6_confirmed_swing_too_old_or_far.insufficient_alone_note: supported width is not required to rescue net RR by itself; the binding target constraint is judged separately by H8

H7_previous_extreme_break_confirmation_t.evidence: pullback extreme to candidate close move, EMA7 reclaim to candidate move, overshoot ATR, and the supplementary pullback-extreme entry reference
H7_previous_extreme_break_confirmation_t.support_rule: median pullback-extreme-to-final-close move consumes at least 40% of the median structural reward distance, or the supplementary pullback-extreme entry reference crosses net RR 1.8 while the frozen references do not
H7_previous_extreme_break_confirmation_t.falsification_rule: counterfactual entry references including the pullback extreme fail to lift net RR toward 1.8

H8_nearest_confirmed_target_too_close.evidence: target distance ATR, required vs actual gap, barrier count before 2.5 ATR
H8_nearest_confirmed_target_too_close.support_rule: median structural reward is below 1.5 ATR while required reward exceeds 5 ATR across years and directions
H8_nearest_confirmed_target_too_close.falsification_rule: 12h reach of required target is rare or stop-first ordering dominates all candidates
